The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Compact. Capable. Built for serious performance.

The Ferris ISX800-52, K24 brings the same rugged commercial engineering and smooth ride quality as its larger counterparts—but in a slightly more compact 52” deck size. Perfect for contractors and serious homeowners looking to get premium performance in tighter spaces, this mower combines maneuverability, comfort, and cutting excellence.

Outfitted with a 24 HP Kawasaki® FT730V engine, the ISX800-52 features Ferris’s ForeFront™ Suspension System and iCD™ Cutting Technology for a precise and comfortable mowing experience, even over uneven terrain.

Features may include:

Kawasaki® Power
Powered by a 24 HP Kawasaki® FT730V V-Twin engine known for durability, smooth operation, and low noise.

ForeFront™ Suspension System
Exclusive independent front suspension system with upper and lower control arms and coil-over shocks for consistent cutting and reduced operator fatigue.

52″ Fabricated Cutting Deck
iCD™ Cutting System enhances cut quality, airflow, and deck durability for professional-level results.

Commercial-Grade Drive System
Hydro-Gear® ZT-3400® transaxles deliver responsive, powerful performance for demanding jobs.

Cut Height Versatility
Cutting height adjustable from 1.5” to 5.0” in 1/4” increments with easy lever control.

Comfort-First Layout
Features a high-back suspension seat, armrests, wide foot area, and vibration-reducing components for long-day comfort.

Fuel Capacity
5.5-gallon fuel tank provides extended operation without frequent refueling.

Ideal for Tight or Mid-Sized Areas
The 52″ deck makes it easier to maneuver in smaller or more detailed spaces without sacrificing commercial performance.
